description.value: Schell Motel Express is a motel located in Vernon, BC, a hub city in the North Okanagan often visited by touring cyclists riding the Okanagan Valley routes. As an express-branded property it likely offers straightforward overnight accommodation in a convenient roadside setting. Cyclists travelling through Vernon may find it a practical stopover, though specific cyclist services are unconfirmed.
